items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: That's what all of them, Joe Alvost, Armstrong, Louis Armstrong, we all used to call people one another cuz.

ctx.x: Cuz. That's what all of them, Joe Alvost, Armstrong, Louis Armstrong, we all used to call people one another cuz. We say cuz, you know, that was the cats, and like they say now, we call them cuz. They used to say cuz.
Lizzie, do you recall any particular anecdotes that you remember now more than anything else about the old days? Is there anything in particular you look back upon and remember? Any?
